# TBPN Merch Store

> > Official merchandise store and content hub for Technology Brothers Podcast Network (TBPN), the daily tech livestream hosted by John Coogan and Jordi Hays covering Silicon Valley, startups, and developer culture.

TBPN is a daily podcast network featuring insights from Silicon Valley insiders, discussions with tech leaders like Marc Andreessen and Sam Altman, and coverage of startups, venture capital, and emerging technologies. The merch store offers official TBPN gear while the blog provides tech guides, community stories, and behind-the-scenes content about the hosts and show.

## Key Topics

- TBPN (Technology Brothers Podcast Network)
- John Coogan - Co-host and entrepreneur
- Jordi Hays - Co-host and investor
- Silicon Valley tech culture
- Daily tech livestream format
- YouTube and X/Twitter presence
- Venture capital and startup metrics
- Developer communities and culture
- Tech personalities (Marc Andreessen, Alex Karp, Sam Altman)
- Web3, AI/ML, and emerging technologies
- Remote-first startups
- Tech tools (GitHub, Figma, Slack, React)
- Podcast merchandise and community gear
- Learning in public and developer advocacy
